name: labs/aaron-mott__keithley-2200
title: Keithley 2200 series programmable DC power supply (KEI2220S)
intro: Keithley 2200 series programmable DC power supply (KEI2220S), adapted from aaron-mott/keithley-2200. It reads `measured_voltage`, `measured_current` and `measured_power`; sets `voltage`, `current`, `output`, `overvoltage_protection` and 1 more; runs `output_off`. `output_off`: disable the output with OUTP OFF (the declared safe state); no input, no output. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
